author: PokerFace
body:
Discord: PokerFace#2575
Timezone: (UTC-10)

I've kind of lost interest in playing competitively for now and would like to offer my services as the positions listed in the title. I've created strategies for Cacalmarin, and hope to create some for another team. If you would like me to help out your team or just gain another perspective on strategies, I can help. You and your team must be able to accept critique and listen well.

I will not accept any starting lineup positions.
